rendered:
The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811. In fact, the paper states that "aqueous processing is compatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, which will simultaneously increase the energy density and decrease the cost of Li-ion batteries." 

The paper does mention that there is some lithium leaching from the NMC 811 into the water during aqueous processing, but this does not seem to be a major issue. The paper states that "even Ni-rich NMC 811 shows only minimal Li^þ leaching (~3 wt%) after one week," and that the aqueous-processed NMC 811 cells still demonstrate very good electrochemical performance. 

Therefore, the paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811.
